description: Sensor, polling rate, battery and Windows pointer settings, plus sensitivity tools for your games.

noMouse.title: No mouse connected
noMouse.body: Connect a supported mouse to tune DPI, polling rate and battery. The pointer settings and sensitivity tools below work with any mouse.

dpi.title: DPI
dpi.hint: Up to {count} stages. The DPI button on the mouse cycles through them. Changes are written when you release the slider.
dpi.unavailable: The current DPI settings could not be read from the mouse.

polling.title: Polling rate
polling.hint: Higher rates feel smoother but use a little more CPU and battery.
polling.test: Measure it in the Test bench

sniper.title: Sniper DPI
sniper.hint: Temporary DPI while a key or mouse button is held. Bind it with the DPI → Sniper action in

lighting.title: Lighting
lighting.hint: Zones: {zones}. Colours and effects follow your lighting profile —

battery.title: Battery
battery.noHistory: Battery history will appear here after a few readings.

pointer.title: Windows pointer
pointer.subtitle: System-wide cursor settings
pointer.notOne: At this speed Windows multiplies every mouse count by ×{mult}, so some counts are skipped or doubled. Keep 10 (the 6th of 11 notches in the old Control Panel) and change DPI instead.
pointer.enhanceHint: Windows mouse acceleration: fast movements travel farther than slow ones. Turn it off for consistent aim; games that use raw input ignore it.
pointer.effective: Desktop feel: {dpi} DPI × pointer speed ≈ {eff} effective DPI.

sens.title: Sensitivity tools
sens.subtitle: eDPI, cm/360 and the same feel across games (hip-fire)
sens.r6Hint: MouseSensitivityMultiplierUnit in GameSettings.ini (default 0.02). Hip-fire only: ADS uses FOV-based multipliers that are not converted.
sens.feelHigh: High sensitivity: quick flicks, harder micro-adjustments.
sens.feelMid: Medium sensitivity: the range most tactical-shooter players use.
sens.feelLow: Low sensitivity: precise aim, needs a large mouse pad.
sens.applyHint: Set this DPI on the active stage of your mouse
sens.note: Converted by matching the distance of a 360° turn. eDPI = DPI × sensitivity and is only comparable within the same game. Fortnite uses the X/Y slider percentage; Siege values are hip-fire with the multiplier set on the left.
